_how_to_add: One entry per place. lat/lon place the pin; photos are files in assets/gallery/ (a large .webp about 1400 px and a -sm.webp thumbnail about 480 px). "wide": true shows a photo across the full width of the panel, uncropped. Add talks and conferences the same way, with kind "talk". A place can also have one "video" (an MP4 in assets/media/ with a poster picture); it plays silently when the pin is hovered or the place is opened. See docs/MAINTAINING.md (Gallery).

places.title: SMAPVEX22 field campaign
places.text: NASA’s SMAP validation experiment in the forests of the US Northeast: surface roughness, soil moisture, bulk density and vegetation, measured on the ground under the satellite.

photos.caption: Measuring surface roughness with a pinboard.
Three TDR sensors measuring soil moisture.
Measuring bulk density: dig out a ring of soil, dry it, and measure the volume of the hole.
Taking soil samples next to the sensors.
Measuring tree height with a laser rangefinder and hypsometer.
Vegetation measurements with the Michigan Tech Research Institute team.
A solar-powered station logging soil moisture through the campaign.
A barred owl watching us from a dead branch in Harvard Forest, 26 July 2022.

places.title: Crop growth stages, field measurements
places.text: Following soybean and corn through the season, counting leaves and measuring plant height, vegetation water content and leaf area index.

photos.caption: Measuring leaf area index with an LAI meter.
Sampling corn for plant height and vegetation water content.
Soybean at the end of the season.

places.title: Across Alaska’s tundra
places.text: After more than a year developing and validating a satellite soil moisture product for northern latitudes, more than 1,200 miles across the tundra it was built for.

photos.caption: On the shore of Cook Inlet in Lake Clark National Park, with the bush plane behind us, 30 May 2023.
Spruce-topped sea stacks from the deck of the boat.
Above a valley of spruce, with snow still on the peaks.
Walking the shore at dusk, with snow on the mountains across the water.

places.title: AgroTrack at AGU24
places.where: Walter E. Washington Convention Center, Washington, DC
places.text: Presenting AgroTrack at AGU’s Annual Meeting: finding when farms irrigate from thermal satellite data, the study I began when I joined NASA.
